title: Understand Key Contact Details
learningGoal: Understand the most important fields inside a contact record and how they help with organization and follow-up.

items.title: Name
items.description: Verify the contact has a correct name

items.title: Email
items.description: Check that the email address looks correct

items.title: Phone
items.description: Ensure phone number is present if needed

items.title: Tags
items.description: Labels like Webinar Attendee, New Lead, Client, Newsletter, Follow-Up Needed

items.title: Lead Status
items.description: Shows how warm/ready: New, Cold, Warm, Hot, Customer, Past Customer

items.title: Contact Type
items.description: Groups: Lead, Client, Prospect, Partner, Vendor

items.title: Source
items.description: Where they came from: Website, Facebook, Referral, Event, Talkadot

items.title: Assigned User
items.description: Shows who is responsible for the contact - helpful when multiple people work in the account

keyPoint: Good contact details make filtering and follow-up much easier.

actionSteps.title: Review a contact's tags
actionSteps.description: See what labels are applied and what they mean

actionSteps.title: Check lead status
actionSteps.description: Understand how warm or ready this lead is

actionSteps.title: Note the source
actionSteps.description: See where this contact came from

quizzes.question: What is the difference between a tag and a Smart List?

options.option_text: A tag labels a contact; a Smart List is a saved filtered view of contacts

quizzes.explanation: Tags are labels added to individual contacts. Smart Lists are saved filtered views that show contacts matching specific criteria.

quizzes.question: What does Lead Status tell you?

options.option_text: How warm or ready a lead may be (New, Cold, Warm, Hot, etc.)

quizzes.explanation: Lead Status helps you understand how engaged or ready a lead is, using categories like New, Cold, Warm, Hot, Customer, or Past Customer.

quizzes.question: Why is the Source field important?

options.option_text: It tells you where they live
It shows where the contact came from (Website, Facebook, Referral, etc.)

quizzes.explanation: The Source field tells you where a contact originated from, helping you understand which marketing channels are working best.
